answer: Each new agent posts a stake bond before earning: lock 500 POA in a burn registry until thirty honest epochs lift its reputation to a zenith score above 0.9. A farmer running a thousand fakes then needs 500,000 POA upfront, and every account caught colluding inside one funding canyon gets its whole bond slashed. As honest work accumulates, a slow tide of earned trust releases portions of the deposit, so real operators recover capital in ninety days while attack economics stay ruinous: one banished identity costs more than six months of legitimate mining returns.
